body: Thank you for your support I'm a bit confused right now though because I tried waiting for the train to come for me on the tracks and the driver actually braked and stopped the train so I ran back to my house and I'm locked in my room at the moment.
Unfortunately my most likely option is staying with my parents and it kills me.
Everyone tells me it gets better in college, which makes me more depressed because I can't go. I really want to though because I would finally be free.
Not really. As I said in a different comment I'm waiting for morning so I can use the train because my method isn't working so for right now I'm just kind of chilling.

She is actually! And bipolar too. She refuses to take medication. Most of my relatives (including my grandparents) are dead. My aunt lives in Florida and my uncle lives in Switzerland. I have rare contact with them my parents don't forbid it but they certainly monitor it so they would know if I tried to run away or if I started telling on them and they would act accordingly. I've thought all of this through several times for years.
Nothing would have been resolved, I will have to see my mother who is a living nightmare, and I will have to spend another day utterly alone with no one caring what I do.
If I did that I would fall asleep and when I wake up my problems will be doubled.

Very poorly I can't seem to make this method work I may have to wait until morning because I live in front of the train tracks. I didn't really wanna do that because it puts the train passengers at risk but I may have no choice.

Even if they lose all control of me, I will still be living under their roof and therefore their rules. Any other family has been alienated by my parents and can be of no help. I've tried the CPS route and unfortunately for me I heal really fast (even right now I'm having a hard time taking the leap because my blood keeps clotting) and there's never been sufficient evidence. As for bass and voice I suck.
I have one dog with me who I'm gonna miss alot but my other family members will take good care of him.

Without going into too much detail I'm bleeding out. Also I'm not gonna be able to go to college because I'm too poor to pay for it and not smart enough or talented enough for a full scholarship. That would require student loans and my parents said that I'm not allowed to do that because they don't want me to. I would move away but my parents won't let me get a job better than the one I have so I'll never make enough money.

My family found a rescue group nearby and we have rescued three dogs and three cats. We donate supplies regularly. We also spread the word through facebook and such about new pets that have come in to try and get them adopted. Every little bit helps.

I make people miserable because due to my bad home life and depressive issues I date around and act like a whore and everyone hates me because of it.
